title: Tom's Pocket Money
text:
Tom is twelve years old. Every Saturday, his parents give him five euros of pocket money. Tom likes to save his money in a red box under his bed. Last month, he saved enough money to buy a small toy car.

On Sunday, Tom went to the shop with his sister, Lucy. Lucy wanted to buy some sweets, but Tom decided to save his money again. He wants to buy a new football next month. He thinks saving money is a good idea.

questions.text: How much pocket money does Tom get every Saturday?
Where does Tom keep his money?
options: In a red box under his bed

questions.text: Why did Tom decide not to buy sweets?
options: He wants to save money for a football

questions.text: What kind of person is Tom most likely to be?

a place where you buy things
chose to do something after thinking about it
small sugary foods, such as candy

paragraph_translations: Tom tiene doce años. Cada sábado, sus padres le dan cinco euros de dinero de bolsillo. A Tom le gusta ahorrar su dinero en una caja roja debajo de su cama. El mes pasado, ahorró suficiente dinero para comprar un pequeño coche de juguete.

El domingo, Tom fue a la tienda con su hermana, Lucy. Lucy quería comprar unos dulces, pero Tom decidió ahorrar su dinero otra vez. Él quiere comprar un balón de fútbol nuevo el próximo mes. Él piensa que ahorrar dinero es una buena idea.
